newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA SELLS 42.156 BLN LEVS 1- AND 4-WK T-BILLS.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA SELLS 42.156 BLN LEVS 1- AND 4-WK T-BILLS.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry on
Thursday sold two discount T-bill issues with maturities of
one week and four weeks, yielding 3.83 percent and 17.69
percent to maturity, respectively, the central bank said.
Bids were received for a total of 42.936 billion levs of
T-bills but the ministry approved bids for 42.156 billion levs
worth of paper.
The issues were offered with no par value or minimum
acceptable price set in advance by the ministry. Auction date
and maturity date for each issue overlap.
Details of the issues follow. Prices are in percent of par:
Issue number BG3022297009 BG3022397007
Term one week four weeks
Issue date March 20 March 20
Maturity date March 27 April 17
Bids received 20,794.2 mln levs 22,141.5 mln levs
Avg price of bids 96.31 pct 84.97
Bids approved 20,064.2 mln levs 22,091.5 mln levs
Avg accepted price 96.31 pct 84.97 pct
Avg yield to maturity 3.83 pct 17.69 pct
